skill.name: server-management
skill.description: Guides production server decisions across process management, monitoring, logging, scaling, health checks, security, and troubleshooting.
skill.summary: Plan reliable server operations using practical principles and decision frameworks.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Static analysis found no suspicious patterns in this prompt-only skill. Manual review found no prompt injection, malicious intent, or unsafe executable behavior.

content.value_statement: Production server decisions can become inconsistent without a clear operating framework. This skill structures choices for processes, monitoring, logs, scaling, health, security, and troubleshooting.
actual_capabilities: Compares process managers for Node.js, general Linux services, containers, and orchestrated workloads.
Defines monitoring categories, alert severities, and suitable observability tools.
Explains log types, rotation, structured logging, severity levels, and sensitive-data controls.
Maps resource and performance symptoms to vertical, horizontal, or automatic scaling decisions.
Provides health-check, server-security, and troubleshooting decision frameworks.
limitations: Provides principles and decision guidance, not executable commands or deployment automation.
Does not inspect live servers, metrics, logs, networks, or cloud accounts.
Requires environment-specific validation before production changes.
Does not replace a tested incident response plan or qualified security review.

use_cases.title: Design a Production Baseline
use_cases.description: Create a practical baseline for process recovery, monitoring, logging, health checks, security, and backups.
use_cases.target_user: DevOps engineers preparing a new production service

use_cases.title: Review Operational Readiness
use_cases.description: Identify missing safeguards and prioritize improvements before a service launch.

use_cases.title: Structure Incident Triage
use_cases.description: Organize checks across processes, logs, resources, networks, and dependencies during an outage.
use_cases.target_user: Application developers responding to production incidents

prompt_templates.title: Create a Server Checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a server management checklist for [application type] running on [platform]. Cover processes, monitoring, logs, health checks, security, and backups.

prompt_templates.title: Choose Process Management
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare suitable process management approaches for [workload]. Consider restart behavior, zero-downtime reloads, clustering, reboot persistence, and operational complexity.

prompt_templates.title: Design Monitoring and Alerts
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a monitoring plan for [service]. Define availability, performance, error, and resource metrics with critical, warning, and informational alert thresholds.

prompt_templates.title: Assess Scaling and Resilience
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess this production architecture: [architecture details]. Recommend investigation, scaling, health-check, logging, and security priorities with assumptions, risks, and validation steps.

output_examples.input: Design an operations baseline for a Node.js API on one Linux server.
output: Use a process manager that restarts crashes and persists across reboots.
Monitor uptime, latency, errors, CPU, memory, and disk capacity.
Rotate structured logs and exclude credentials and personal data.
Add service and dependency health checks.
Use SSH keys, a non-root account, limited ports, patches, and scheduled backups.

output_examples.input: Help triage a service with slow responses and high memory use.
output_examples.output: Confirm the process is healthy, inspect error and access logs, measure memory trends, profile the application, and validate dependencies before scaling.

output_examples.input: Recommend an alert strategy for a customer-facing API.
output: Critical alerts cover outages, severe error rates, and exhausted resources.
Warning alerts cover degrading latency, capacity trends, and dependency instability.
Informational events support daily review without immediate interruption.

best_practices: Profile bottlenecks and validate evidence before changing capacity.
Use layered monitoring across availability, performance, errors, and resources.
Test operational changes in the target environment with rollback procedures.
anti_patterns: Do not run application services as root.
Do not scale before investigating the actual bottleneck.
Do not log secrets or operate without rotation, monitoring, and backups.

faq.question: Does this skill execute server commands?
faq.answer: No. It provides decision frameworks and operational guidance without running commands.

faq.question: Which process managers does it cover?
faq.answer: It discusses PM2, systemd, Docker, Podman, Kubernetes, and Docker Swarm by workload type.

faq.question: Can it design a monitoring plan?
faq.answer: Yes. It organizes availability, performance, errors, resources, alert severity, and tool selection.

faq.question: Does it support incident troubleshooting?
faq.answer: Yes. It prioritizes process status, logs, resources, networks, and dependencies.

faq.question: Can it recommend a scaling approach?
faq.answer: Yes. It relates workload symptoms to profiling, vertical scaling, horizontal scaling, and automatic scaling.

faq.question: Is the guidance sufficient for production changes?
faq.answer: No. Validate every recommendation against the environment, permissions, safety boundaries, tests, and rollback requirements.
